usage: Three new portrait atlas assets, then transparent-background edits; one file per country.
atlasPrompt: Create one NEW character portrait atlas asset for a Korean three kingdoms game. Attached silla-faces-v2.png is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Keep 2D female chibi warm brown clean outlines, softly painted anime shading, handmade texture and Korean period costume. EXACTLY FIVE distinct adult female general head-and-neck portraits on an exact 3-column by 2-row equal-cell grid. Fill upper-left, upper-center, upper-right, lower-left, lower-center. Leave lower-right empty. Landscape 3:2, square cells. No gridlines, text, UI, numbers, hands or weapons. Uniform head size, fully contained hair and ornaments, 15% transparent margins. Faction yellow / blue / red. Distinct silhouettes, faces and hairstyles. Genuine transparent alpha.
transparencyEditPrompt: Edit this exact five-character atlas. Remove ONLY the entire brown/grey/red/black vignette background and make ALL space outside the five characters genuinely fully transparent alpha. Keep the same exact five women facial identities, colors, hairstyles, jewelry, clothes, portrait sizes, and exact 3-column by 2-row positions (lower right empty). No redesign, no added characters, no text, no checkerboard, no gradients, no glow, no cast shadows. Clean transparent cutouts of the five head-and-collar portraits.
